description: Turns experience into a reusable lesson in .hexagen/skills/ (indexed by search_knowledge_base and suggested automatically when a similar check fails). Call after fixing a failure that run_quality_assurance reported as resolved (pass its episodeId), or whenever you learn a project-specific fix or convention. Pass updateId to improve an existing lesson instead of duplicating it.

agent.description: The agent role making this call (e.g. "dev", "qa", "e2e"), so its work is attributed to it. Defaults to HEXACORE_AGENT.

episodeId.description: The resolved failure this lesson was learned from

example.description: A short code example or before/after

problem.description: When it applies: symptoms, error messages, situations

solution.description: What to do, as concrete steps or rules

stack.description: Stack it applies to (default: the episode stack, else "any")

title.description: Short imperative name, e.g. "Register new Rust slices in mod.rs"

updateId.description: Lesson id to rewrite (keeps its usage history)

name: record_lesson
title: Record a lesson
